description: Optional local models Recon3D can use. Nothing here is required: the engine ships a complete classical CPU pipeline. Every entry is an open-source model that runs locally with no API key and no cloud service. Licences are recorded per model so you can decide what is acceptable for your project.

models.name: Depth Anything V2 (Small)
models.purpose: Monocular depth prior for denser point clouds and better concave detail

files.name: depth_anything_v2_vits.onnx
files.note: Community ONNX export of the Apache-2.0 Small checkpoint. The checksum is recorded after the first successful download; supply your own export if you prefer.

models.notes: Only the Small checkpoint is Apache-2.0. Base/Large/Giant are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and are deliberately NOT offered.

models.name: U2Net-p salient object detection
models.purpose: Alternative background removal for busy/transparent reference images
models.notes: Small (4 MB) salient-object model; useful when the background is not a plain colour.

download_policy.checksum: sha256 recorded on first download, verified on every use afterwards
download_policy.never: no model is fetched implicitly during a reconstruction; `recon3d models download` is explicit
